benchmark: S&P 500 total return for the default S&P 500 universe; otherwise declare a matching total-return benchmark
signal: Equal arithmetic mean of Value, Quality and Momentum; equal weights within each family
normalization: Bounded midrank: 2 * (count_below + 0.5 * count_equal) / count - 1; no additional winsorization
taxonomy: GICS codes from a single dated mapping; identifiers and mapping source retained in each snapshot
accounting: USD, latest publicly available TTM and balance sheet as of cutoff; reported GAAP plus separately sourced Nareit FFO for equity REITs; no discretionary addbacks in the score
issuer_rule: Highest ADV20 share class, then symbol ascending; issuer-wide market cap for all classes; incomplete class liquidity blocks issuer selection
missing_data: No imputation or weight renormalization; missing issuer stays unranked and makes universe-wide comparison incomplete
analyst_targets_and_peg: Not scored or required for discovery
earnings_revisions: Separate future profile only with point-in-time consensus data
risk_overlay: GARCH, GJR-GARCH and EGARCH affect risk ceilings only
